answer: The glacier counter is kept in pigment and tide shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1790 identities would post 2686 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
